plan.candidate_scope: All nine frozen lifetime-cost scenarios, both Decision Tree and Random Forest. No scenario chosen by non-zstd share or favorable performance. Nine deadline settings remain oracle diagnostics, not classification targets.

training.split_rule: Recompute original seed-group split and require byte-referenced assignments to agree. Fit original train IDs only; original test IDs are descriptive development diagnostics because the full Pilot was previously explored.
training.model_settings: Exact current config decision_tree/random_forest dictionaries; no tuning, class balancing, resampling, calibration or refit on external files
training.inputs: Exactly FEATURE_NAMES in existing order, pre-compression statistics only
training.baselines: All four constant codecs and scenario-specific training-label majority; deterministic codec-order ties
training.separation: New labels, models and summaries in this study only. Existing official labels, models and configuration remain unchanged.

corpus.selection: Explicitly select all 60 already reviewed candidates. Validate unchanged hashes, quotas, groups, approval and notices; no feature, prediction or compression-based selection/replacement.
corpus.notice_policy: Preserve usage_requirements, source/citation/relationship records and byte-exact copies of unique required notices with a path/hash index including PSF adaptation summary.
corpus.eligibility: Generic manifest remains evaluation_ready=false and declared_metadata_only; this study separately checks reviewed metadata and reconstructed-synthetic overlap evidence. No anonymity, exhaustive lineage or statistical independence certification.

measurement.predictions: Freeze all corpus features, model hashes, predictions and uncalibrated class probabilities before the first corpus benchmark; no later model/scenario selection
measurement.codec: Existing Compare Mode per file; gzip9,bz2_9,lzma6,zstd3, five repeats per compression/decompression, perf_counter_ns, median ms, exact byte verification, original raw reports retained
measurement.order: Files sorted by origin_group_id then full sample_id. Fixed codec order and fixed E2E strategy order are limitations, not randomized causal estimates.
measurement.failure: No retries, sample removal or repeat replacement. Preserve exceptions/failed slots. No successful study claim unless all required inputs, predictions, codecs and E2E trials complete.

evaluation.primary: For each scenario/model, mean over origin groups of within-group (model policy-cost regret minus training-majority regret); negative indicates lower loss on this fixed corpus
evaluation.secondary: Pooled accuracy, Macro F1 over all four codecs with zero_division=0, 4x4 confusion matrix, policy cost and regret, size/codec times, per-format/group coverage and all failure counts
evaluation.reporting: All scenario/model outcomes including worse-than-baseline, absent classes and high-confidence errors. Descriptive fixed-corpus comparison, no population significance claim. No 10 percent class-share acceptance target.
evaluation.official_v2: Original Compare v2 labels retained as reference; no official model/score deployment change. New policy-cost regret is not numerically comparable to old logarithmic score regret.

end_to_end.strategies: Fixed zstd and every scenario's Decision Tree/Random Forest, no oracle selection used by execution
end_to_end.compress_phase: Within an existing Python process with resident model: read original -> hash -> feature extraction -> predict -> one selected codec -> decompress/byte verification -> write payload and research-package manifest. Prepared output directory is outside timer.
end_to_end.restore_phase: Read research manifest and payload -> verify payload hash -> decompress -> verify original size/hash -> write restored original filename; exact source-byte comparison also checked
end_to_end.cost: Policy coefficients applied to measured package bytes and medians of these two pipeline phases; use the same stored fixed-zstd trials for all scenarios. Report overhead-aware costs alongside pure-codec costs.
end_to_end.loading: Measure verified model file read/hash/deserialization separately five times and report raw and median load time; model loading is outside warm pipeline timing. No cold-process-startup performance claim.
end_to_end.limits: Research engine package, not deployed Smart CLI/GUI. Includes Python/feature/prediction/verification/file I/O work but excludes process startup, filesystem durability fsync, trained model distribution/storage and network/energy/memory. OS caches and fixed strategy order remain limitations.

eligibility_scope: Ready for this predeclared local candidate study, subject to manifest/metadata/source fences; not generic evaluation_ready or independence certification.
